extracted.name: Sautéed cabbage
extracted.description: Do something different with cabbage – fry it with onions and apple cider vinegar to make this simple side that works very well with pork
ingredient_lines: 1 tbsp apple cider vinegar or the juice of ½ lemon
instruction_lines: Quarter the cabbage, then slice into ½- 1cm wide strips, working from tip to root and discarding the core.

Heat the oil in a large, heavy-based frying pan over a high heat and cook the onion and cabbage for 5-6 mins, stirring until the cabbage starts to catch a little in places. Lower the heat, add the butter, some salt and pepper and cook for a further 4-5 mins until the cabbage is tender. Add the vinegar or lemon juice, check the seasoning and serve straightaway.
